verdict.line: You lose if you eat the Q (Thundering Smash) stun into a double W (Frenzied Maul) heal-burst; you win if you force him to spend W (Frenzied Maul) once and punish before he can recast it.

brief.thesis: K'Sante holds the lane and solo-kill edge (50.6% over 1478 games) because his Q (Ntofo Strikes) stacks into a pull that negates Volibear's need to walk into stun range, and his E (Footwork) shield answers Volibear's W (Frenzied Maul) poke-and-heal pattern. The matchup is still even in shape because Volibear's Q (Thundering Smash) gap-close-stun and R (Stormbringer) bonus health both threaten to flip a bad trade into a kill before K'Sante hits his power spikes.

theirWindow.when: his Q (Thundering Smash) is off cooldown near you
theirWindow.what: Thundering Smash stuns and damages the first enemy he attacks after the speed boost. Don't stand in his dash lane at low HP, since a stun into double W (Frenzied Maul, 5s cooldown) recast is his whole burst package.

yourWindow.when: you land a second Q (Ntofo Strikes) hit
yourWindow.what: Two Q stacks fire a shockwave that pulls him in, letting you follow with W (Path Maker) for the charge-up damage reduction into a knockback stun. This is your highest-value all-in window before his W recast is back up.

powerCurve.note: Q stun gap-close before your E shield matters
Q pull-shockwave and Second Wind sustain trades
his R grants bonus health, resets faster
W/E cooldowns shrink, All Out online at 6

start.why: 88.9% pick rate and the higher winrate start (50.7% over 1560 games); the extra health and sustain blunt Volibear's passive bonus magic damage proc on his attacks.

boots.why: Slightly higher winrate (50.5% over 835 games) and the tenacity cuts the duration of his Q (Thundering Smash) stun and the slows from E (Sky Splitter) and R (Stormbringer).

core.why: Highest-winrate core path starts here (62.5% over 40 games); grievous wounds and early armor blunt his W (Frenzied Maul) recast heal.
Adds the wave clear and CDR that lets your Q (Ntofo Strikes, 3.5s cooldown) stack faster for repeated shockwave pulls.
Stacks more grievous wounds onto his W (Frenzied Maul) heal and Stormbringer sustain, and adds armor against his physical poke.
Scales your health pool so his R (Stormbringer) bonus-health engage doesn't one-shift the fight.

situational.when: he is building burst magic damage alongside his passive proc and you need the magic shield instead of Thornmail
you need more sustain in extended trades rather than more grievous wounds

runes.keystoneWhy: Higher-winrate page (49.8% vs 46.8%) and it rewards the point-and-click poke trades you want to run with Q (Ntofo Strikes) rather than racing his W (Frenzied Maul) double-cast.

summoners.why: Flash + Ignite has the best measured winrate here (51.7% over 21.5% pick) and matches your solo-kill advantage by denying his W (Frenzied Maul) recast heal in all-ins; Flash + Teleport is the more commonly picked (73%) safer option if you're prioritizing scaling and map presence over early kills.

playing.title: Hold E until his Q is down
playing.detail: Don't burn your E (Footwork) shield into a trade where Volibear's Q (Thundering Smash, 12-10s cooldown) is still up, since the stun into his W (Frenzied Maul) recast is his only real burst chain.

playing.title: Punish after his first W
playing.detail: Frenzied Maul is only 5s cooldown, but the bonus damage and heal come from the recast on the same mark. Trade hard right after he lands the first W and before he can tag you again.

playing.title: Stack Q before committing
playing.detail: Land two Q (Ntofo Strikes) hits to trigger the pull shockwave before using W (Path Maker), so he can't walk out of your knockback-stun range.

playing.title: Charge W into his E poke
playing.detail: Path Maker takes reduced damage while charging up; use that window to soak a Sky Splitter (E, 16s cooldown, 1200 range) cast instead of eating it full force.

playing.title: Respect R at level 6
playing.detail: Stormbringer grants him bonus health and area slow+damage on landing, and towers near his landing spot get disabled. Don't fight below 50% HP right as he hits 6.

playing.title: Track his R cooldown drop
playing.detail: Stormbringer drops from 160s to 110s by rank 3 (level 11), so expect faster repeat engages mid-game than his level 6 timing suggests.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and winrate figures are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the ability breakdowns, trade timing, and tactical reasoning are my own analysis layered on top of that data.
